column1: # NLRtracker clade definitions - generated by build_clade_table.py
# Anchors are RefPlantNLR identifiers from Table S1's Subclass column.
# role: anchored = clade is the MRCA of its anchors
#       tree_defined = derived from the tree, see notes
#       outgroup = used to root the tree
# Subfamily parents set from the tree 2026-08-06: each sits >80% inside CC-01 or CC-02, so the
# hierarchy is CC-NLR > CC-01/CC-02 > subfamily. Before this they hung directly off CC-NLR,
# which made a protein anchoring both CC-01 and CNL8 look ambiguous when it is simply nested.
# CNL16 withdrawn 2026-08-06. Five of its six anchors (Rpi-ber1.1, Rpi-ber1.2,
# Rpi-chc1.2, Rpi-tar1.1, Rpi-tub1.3) are not in RefPlantNLR at all, so the clade
# never formed and nothing could ever be called CNL16. Restore it when the
# RefPlantNLR dataset is updated and those receptors are present.
# MIC1 merged into RGA5 2026-08-06. They are one group, and RGA5 names its
# genetic linkage to RGA4 as a paired sensor and helper.
